data_authority_v3.portable_resolution: --data-root | TRADING_AGENTIC_DATA_ROOT | shared main-repo data root | official source reconstruction

archive_validity_vs_decision_eligibility.ARCHIVE_DAY_VALIDITY: OI_ARCHIVE_DAY_VALIDITY_LEDGER_V2.jsonl is a forensic data-quality artifact ONLY; it MUST NOT directly control historical decision eligibility — eligibility is timestamp-scoped causal (PIT) per decision_time
archive_validity_vs_decision_eligibility.DECISION_ELIGIBILITY_AT_T: strictly causal (data_time <= T): completed 1h price bar exists; CURRENT_HOUR_OI_COMPLETENESS = exactly 12 distinct 5m OI snapshots in the completed hour; previous-hour reference complete; rolling feature history >= 336 valid hourly OI changes; last observation not stale (<= 600s); no conflicting duplicate <= T. No final UTC-day validity; no observations > T. A gap strictly AFTER T must not alter eligibility or feature/signal state at T (adversarially tested in PIT_CAUSALITY_V2_REPORT).

common_window_utc.pre_common_auxiliary_data: BTCUSDT 2020-09-01..2021-11-30 OI preserved as PRE_COMMON_AUXILIARY_DATA; MUST NOT influence hypothesis selection, thresholds, metrics or performance (default frozen here)

cost_model.definition: 10 bps is the TOTAL modeled round-trip trading friction (single canonical number; not decomposed into per-side fees/slippage)
cost_model.primary_gate_application: primary economic gates use 10 bps TOTAL RT
cost_model.sensitivity_role: diagnostic robustness only, NOT parameter selection

economics.decision_spacing: NO COOLDOWN / ONE DECISION PER COMPLETED ASSET-HOUR

decision_timeframe.oi_aggregation_rule: causal V2: use only 5m observations with oi_time <= decision_time; CURRENT_HOUR_OI_COMPLETENESS requires exactly 12 distinct snapshots in the completed decision hour; previous-hour reference also 12; PIT timestamp-scoped reads (oi_state_at) with no final UTC-day validity gate
decision_timeframe.pit_invariant: oi_time <= decision_time for every observation used; no day-level future validity query

direction_semantics.LONG: price UP (close > open) AND delta_oi > 0 AND z_oi >= +1.0
direction_semantics.NO_TRADE: delta_oi <= 0, or z_oi < +1.0, or price close == open, or any NO_SIGNAL condition
direction_semantics.SHORT: price DOWN (close < open) AND delta_oi > 0 AND z_oi >= +1.0
direction_semantics.no_inferred_direction: direction derives only from the frozen price/OI definitions above

economics.entry_timing: next 1h bar OPEN (the bar immediately after the decision hour)
economics.experiment_invalidation: spec/manifest hash drift, dataset fingerprint drift, or any execution before this prereg is committed => experiment invalid

feature_transformations.definition: sum_open_interest(last 5m snapshot of completed hour H) - sum_open_interest(last 5m snapshot of completed hour H-1); base-asset units; requires exactly 12 distinct snapshots in BOTH hours, else NO_TRADE for that hour
feature_transformations.name: delta_oi_1h

feature_transformations.definition: ROBUST location/scale z-score of delta_oi_1h: z = (delta_oi - rolling_median) / (1.4826 * rolling_MAD) over the trailing 30 calendar days (720 completed hourly changes) strictly BEFORE the decision time; if MAD == 0 => NO_TRADE (causal; PIT timestamp-scoped)
feature_transformations.name: z_oi
feature_transformations.note: single frozen robust definition; rolling std is NOT used; no alternative scale was evaluated
feature_transformations.window: 30d trailing, center=median, scale=1.4826*MAD, min 336 valid historical observations

feature_transformations.definition: completed decision-hour close > open => UP; close < open => DOWN; close == open => NO_TRADE
feature_transformations.name: price_direction_1h

forbidden_until_execution_checkpoint: performance metric computation on real data

funding_accounting.note: funding is NOT silently zero forever; any promotion requires a funding materiality audit
funding_accounting.reason: no PIT-safe authoritative funding series exists in the repository for all three assets (BTCUSDT deep series exists in docs/external-audit-01/carry-funding-deep-01/; ETHUSDT/SOLUSDT do not)

economics.insufficient_sample_policy: if realized N < minimum_N, or any gate dataset is missing, result = INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE / REPAIR_REQUIRED; no parameter relaxation, no window extension to chase N

minimum_N.note: hours are the independent unit; non-overlapping 1h outcomes per asset; if realized N is below minimum, result is INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLE (a FAIL-class outcome, not a promotion)

orthogonality_gates.H5_PNL_CORRELATION: NOT_EVALUABLE_FROM_PERSISTED_EVIDENCE (H5 daily PnL arrays were never persisted; do not regenerate H5)
orthogonality_gates.comparator: the exact preregistered ROC(24h) momentum proxy definition (frozen before H6 execution; daily series construction frozen before execution)
orthogonality_gates.implementation: CORRECT Pearson implementation, verified by the standard self-test r(X,X)=1, r(X,-X)=-1, constant series guarded
orthogonality_gates.violation: violation => no promotion regardless of economics

pass_fail_semantics.FAIL_is_terminal: any unmet gate => DISCOVERY_FAIL, terminal, recorded in FAILED_RESEARCH_MEMORY.md; post-hoc subcells are POST_HOC_LEAD_ONLY and never promoted
pass_fail_semantics.PASS_requires: ALL of: minimum_N met, net expectancy > 0 at 10 bps TOTAL RT, P(Sharpe>0) >= 0.90, permutation p <= 0.05, Sharpe CI excludes 0, halves + thirds + walk-forward consistent, |daily corr vs momentum proxy| <= 0.50, funding materiality gate if promoted
pass_fail_semantics.no_rerun: no rerun, no retuning, no threshold change after first economic execution

robustness_gates: halves consistency: sign of net expectancy must agree across first/second half of the common window
thirds consistency: at least 2 of 3 thirds positive net expectancy
walk-forward: rolling 3-fold forward evaluation must not have all folds negative

z_oi.update: strictly trailing, recompute per decision hour from PIT data only

threshold_rule.contraction_condition: NO_TRADE: OI contraction hours (delta_oi <= 0) produce NO_TRADE regardless of z (a contraction-reversal variant would be a separate preregistered experiment)
threshold_rule.example_repaired: median=-10, MAD=1, delta_oi=-8 => z=1.349 BUT delta_oi<0 => NO_TRADE (previously would have fired; now blocked)
threshold_rule.expansion_condition_detail: qualifying expansion requires BOTH raw OI expansion (current delta_oi > 0, base-asset units) AND robust_z_oi >= 1.0; positive z alone with delta_oi <= 0 is NOT qualifying (contraction never qualifies even if z >= 1 due to negative median/MAD). If MAD == 0 => NO_TRADE (H6 V2 raw-sign rule, EXT-CONS-004 repair).
threshold_rule.neutral_or_insufficient: delta_oi <= 0, or z_oi < +1.0, or MAD == 0, or < 336 historical observations => NO_TRADE/NO_SIGNAL
threshold_rule.note: thresholds frozen BEFORE any performance observation; NO parameter sweep is permitted; changing these values after any economic execution invalidates the experiment

governance.PRE_LEDGER_CONFIRMATION_HISTORY: NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_PROVEN (LIMITATION_EXPLICIT_NON_BLOCKING for V3: V3 decisions depend on no prior confirmation results)

prereg_commit: PENDING (filled by freeze commit step; this field is completed by the post-commit record, not self-referentially here)
supersession_condition: V3 supersedes V2 only after independent external verification; until then V3 is PENDING_EXTERNAL_VERIFICATION_V3
